description: Ex-INS Vikrant White Tigers Sea Hawk on a concrete platform in flying attitude with drop tanks and dummy rockets, serial painted large on nose. Photographed at Changampuzha Park, Edappally, in May 2025 (NIE): engines removed, maintained and repainted by the Navy about 2022; park itself renovated and reopened Sep 2024. WoI 2008 gave the location vaguely as Pallady. Source NIE 12 May 2025, WoI, Wikipedia survivors list.
